item.description:
Production Desk 1.5.1

  • Report bugs and crashes from Production settings with a description, technical summary, and reviewable email draft.
  • Remember detected errors and interrupted desktop sessions locally for reporting after restart. Copy or save reports when an email app is unavailable.
  • Plan coverage on the original PDF with drawing tools, camera movements, revision-specific marks, and lined PDF export.
  • Draw coverage before choosing a shot, then create or link a shot with the line’s camera details.
  • Include coverage page references and timing notes in shot lists, CSV exports, and printed reports.
  • Preserve productions, original PDFs, manual shot notes, and Undo/Redo while linking or unlinking coverage.
